row.notes: Game_Mfd_FuelMix_BuildOptions, Max-row gate: add eax,-0xf; cmp eax,3 (6 bytes, 0x141788c9a..0x141788c9f), then jb 0x141788cc3 skips the 'max' AddRow (id 3, lng_hud_fuel_max) when eax = session type [[sub+0xf0]+0x1a8]+4 is 15..17 (which sessions these are is not proven by these bytes). Reached only when mask bit 3 is set (test bl,8 at 0x141788c0d/0x141788c84 -> 0x141788c89). eax is dead after the jb (both paths call 0x141789520 / 0x141789070 without reading it), so a site handler that writes c.rax = 0 makes the jb fall through and offers Max for that call only (e.g. only while an add-on's season is active). No branch lands in 0x141788c9b..0x141788c9f (disassembly of 0x141788bc0..0x141788d3b). Process-wide SWOFTY_PATCH form: 83 C0 F1 83 F8 00 (cmp eax,0, the jb is never taken). Replaces the own 2-byte write 72 21 -> 90 90 at 0x141788ca0 in the vmknolle season labels DLLs.
